📢 Impact Internship – Human Resources Opportunity @ BAT Indonesia (Jakarta)📢

In this role you'll:
🔹 Provide day-to-day operational and administrative support to the Human Resources team
🔹 Support the delivery of HR processes and activities across the employee lifecycle
🔹 Assist in coordinating and executing key people-related projects and HR initiatives
🔹 Work closely with stakeholders across the business to ensure smooth HR operations
🔹 Support employee data management, documentation, and reporting activities
🔹 Prepare presentations, reports, and analysis to support HR decision-making
🔹 Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives to enhance HR processes and employee experience
🔹 Support ad-hoc HR projects and activities while gaining valuable exposure to a dynamic global organization

What we're looking for:
🔹 Strong written and verbal English communication skills
🔹 Intermediate Microsoft Excel skills, including data analysis and reporting
🔹 Basic Microsoft PowerPoint skills with the ability to prepare clear and structured presentations
🔹 Good attention to detail, particularly when handling employee data and HR documentation
🔹 Strong interpersonal and communication skills
🔹 Ability to work effectively both independently and collaboratively within a team environment
🔹 Eagerness to learn, adapt, and contribute in a fast-paced workplace
🔹 Passion for building a career in Human Resources and gaining global business exposure

🔗 Apply now: https://lnkd.in/gbCyjrcM
